headline: Sensex jumps 1,109 points and Nifty ends above 22,700 following FM's comments on LTCG and STT.

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Finance Minister's comments regarding Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG) and Securities Transaction Tax (STT)
Strong outperformance in the IT and Realty sectors during the trading session
RBI intervention in the forex market and fresh curbs that supported the Indian Rupee
Market rebound following previous session losses caused by oil price spikes and foreign fund outflows
whatHappening: The Sensex closed 1,109 points higher while the Nifty 50 ended at 22,722
The Indian Rupee outperformed its Asian peers following central bank intervention and new FX curbs
Global safe-haven demand rose following a selloff in international tech stocks and falling bond yields
The market recovery follows an extended period of losses over the previous eight weeks
summary: The Indian stock market witnessed a major rally today, with the Sensex surging 1,109 points and Nifty closing above 22,700. Gains were driven by the Finance Minister's remarks on LTCG and STT, alongside significant strength in IT and Realty sectors. Additionally, the Rupee appreciated against Asian peers following RBI intervention and new currency curbs.
